name: Finance
key_conventions: Professional qualifications and certifications (e.g. ACCA, CFA, CIMA) are often listed prominently where held
Accuracy, regulatory compliance, and discretion with sensitive financial data are commonly emphasised
Quantifiable achievements (e.g. cost savings, portfolio size, process improvements) are often valued
regulatory_considerations: Many finance roles are subject to specific regulatory requirements (e.g. FCA regulation in the UK) and may require background or reference checks
Handling of client financial data is commonly subject to data protection and confidentiality requirements
terminology_notes: 'FCA' — the Financial Conduct Authority, the main UK financial services regulator
'AML' — anti-money laundering, a common compliance topic in finance roles
source_note: General conventions only, based on common finance-sector recruitment practice — individual employers, regulators, and roles vary, and the specific job description should always take priority.
